Container.Name: telegram-downloader
Container.Overview: Self-hosted daemon that automatically downloads media from Telegram channels, groups, and forum topics. Configure sources, filters, and daemon mode with environment variables. This container has no web UI. First-run authentication: Unraid's container console cannot accept the Telegram login code. Stop the container, run a one-shot interactive container against the same Sessions path (see the Install on Unraid section of the project README), enter the code sent to your Telegram account, then start this container. Get API credentials at https://my.telegram.org/apps
Container.Requires: Telegram API credentials from https://my.telegram.org/apps, and a one-shot interactive login before the first daemon start.
Container.Changes: Add the initial Unraid Community Applications template.

Config.Name: Sessions
Config.Description: Telegram session file and download state. Back this up. After a first-run login, telegram_downloader.session lives here.

Config.Name: Phone Number
Config.Description: Phone number with country code, for example +1234567890. Used for the first-run login.

Config.Name: Source URL
Config.Description: First Telegram source, for example https://t.me/channel_name or https://t.me/c/1234567890/1. Add TDL_SOURCES_1_URL, TDL_SOURCES_2_URL, and so on for more sources.

Config.Name: Daemon Mode
Config.Description: Run continuously and check sources on an interval. Leave this enabled after the first-run login.

Config.Name: Check Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between source checks (60-86400). Default is 300.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, for example Europe/Lisbon. Used for scheduled active hours.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for downloaded file ownership. Unraid's nobody user is 99. Use the same value in the first-run login container.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for downloaded file ownership. Unraid's users group is 100.

Config.Name: Notifications
Config.Description: Enable download notifications. To use Discord, add TDL_NOTIFICATIONS_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL with a real URL. A blank value fails startup.
